prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one game sprite strip for a 2D Sengoku beat-em-up
Primary request: Using the supplied eighth-figure enemy sheet only as exact design reference, create the fallen mounted samurai rider alone, with NO horse in any cell. He is the lower-left mounted samurai in the sheet: gold-horn kabuto, dark navy armor, long flowing blue cape, black boots and armor, wielding the same polearm/naginata. Keep identity and costume recognizable.
Style: match the supplied detailed painted game sprite exactly.
Composition: ONE horizontal row of exactly 4 equal 384x384 cells, total image 1536x384. One full fallen rider per cell. Face/body remain oriented RIGHT, grounded consistent scale, head and torso size consistent. Complete polearm and entire cape in every frame, compact natural silhouette within centered cell, at least 16px margin; no overlap across frames. The horse is entirely absent.
Background exactly uniform RGB(255,0,255). No text, labels, border, grid, shadow or ground.
